texts: Whenever a senior Keeper retires, an heir inherits that Keeper's lantern-station.
Whenever a senior Keeper dies, an heir inherits that Keeper's lantern-station.
A Keeper's family keeps that Keeper's inherited station.
The Council must approve any station transfer.

fields.sentence: Whenever a senior Keeper retires, an heir inherits that Keeper's lantern-station.
parse: (: whenever_retire_inherit (Implication (And (Member $e retire) (Agent $e $k) (Member $k senior_keeper)) (And (Member (sk_heir $k) heir) (Member (sk_inherit $k) inherit) (Agent (sk_inherit $k) (sk_heir $k)) (Theme (sk_inherit $k) (sk_lantern_station $k)) (Member (sk_lantern_station $k) lantern_station) (Possession (sk_lantern_station $k) $k) (During (sk_inherit $k) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: The whenever rule keys its Skolem terms on the keeper variable $k rather than on the trigger-occurrence variable $e that the every-time example uses, a departure from 'a Skolem event per occurrence' that is harmless here because a keeper retires once. senior_keeper's genus plus gradable-modifier decomposition, lantern_station's genus with the noun modifier left unexposed, the Possession genitive and the During link all match the stated rules.

fields.sentence: Whenever a senior Keeper dies, an heir inherits that Keeper's lantern-station.
parse: (: f81_rule (Implication (And (Member $k senior_keeper) (Member $d die) (Patient $d $k)) (And (Member (sk_heir $k) heir) (Member (sk_inherit $k) inherit) (Agent (sk_inherit $k) (sk_heir $k)) (Theme (sk_inherit $k) (sk_station $k)) (Member (sk_station $k) lantern_station) (Possession (sk_station $k) $k) (During (sk_inherit $k) $d))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A presupposed definite NP inside a whenever-rule's consequent — 'that Keeper's lantern-station' already exists when the trigger fires, but the instruction set only says premises are the pattern to match and conclusions are what to mint, and never states whether such a referent should be bound as a premise conjunct or minted as a Skolem function in the conclusion (the definite-projection doctrine is written for seals, not for rules).
review.notes: Whenever routing, plain-variable premises, the During tie to the trigger, the dependent Skolem heir, Possession with the possessed first for the genitive, and both senior_keeper decomposition atoms (gradable adjective modifier exposed) are all per spec.

fields.sentence: A Keeper's family keeps that Keeper's inherited station.

q2_gaps: A characterizing generic whose subject is a SINGULAR INDEFINITE with a co-varying anaphor ("A Keeper's family keeps THAT Keeper's inherited station"). The Existential section rules that 'a/an' with a verbal predicate is a witness and reserves the generic/rule form for bare plurals and explicit quantifiers, and Donkey anaphora only maps a bound pronoun to a rule variable under an explicit quantifier - so a world rule stated in this form has no licensed universal encoding and can only be recorded as a one-off existential.
review.notes: Every local decision is doctrine-correct (Possession for both genitives possessed-first, participial 'inherited' kept as an adjective on the witness, keep -> Theme, singular collective 'family' with no GroupOf and no distribution, habitual so no tense). The consequence of the gap is that the sentence's generalization over Keepers is recorded as a single existential situation.

fields.sentence: The Council must approve any station transfer.

q2_gaps: free-choice 'any' as a universal determiner has no entry in the quantifier-to-strength dial (all/every, most, a lot of, many, few, no/none) and no stated QuantifierPhrase treatment

a deontic on a SPECIFIC individual subject scoped over a universally quantified OBJECT: the instruction set gives (Obligated e) for a one-off act and the reified (Inheritance kind (obligated action)) for a kind-level norm, but not this rule-plus-(Obligated e) hybrid, and does not say whether it takes the universal rule's 0.9 confidence or a plain norm's 0.99
review.notes: The structure follows the stated forms exactly: the shared-existential/universal shape with the Council as a constant and the range over station_transfer, Theme for approve (as in the 'committee approved the plan' example), the noun-modifier compound genus, and a capitalized-common-noun label with no Name atom. Only the 0.99 rule confidence is arguable against the Quantifiers section's stated 0.9 for distributing rules.
